text.en: Oh — you're here! Hi hi, {name}! I've been waiting for you.
text.zh-CN: 哦——你来啦！嗨嗨，{name}！我一直在等你呢。

text.en: Welcome to Catopia — our little island, floating all on its own in a big quiet sea.
text.zh-CN: 欢迎来到 Catopia——我们的小岛，独自漂在一片安静的大海上。

text.en: I'm Cato — I live right here on the island. Now that you're here, we get to look after this place side by side. Friends!
text.zh-CN: 我是 Cato——就住在这座岛上。你来了以后，我们就能并肩一起照看这座小岛啦。是朋友喔！

text.en: Let me show you a few things around the house — quick tour!
text.zh-CN: 我带你认识一下屋子边上的几样东西吧——很快的！

text.en: This is your mailbox. When something arrives, tap it to open it up and collect your gifts and letters.
text.zh-CN: 这是你的邮箱。有东西寄到时，点一下就能打开，收下礼物和信件。

text.en: Over here is the storage chest. Tap it to stash things away or grab them back — when your bag is full, this is where the extra goes.
text.zh-CN: 这边是储物箱。点开它可以存东西、也可以拿回来——背包装满了，多出来的就放这儿。

text.en: This tablet is for shopping. Tap it to place orders — seeds, tools, all sorts of goodies.
text.zh-CN: 这个平板是用来买东西的。点开它就能下单——种子、工具，各种好东西都有。

text.en: And this is the work station. Tap it to craft new things out of the materials you gather.
text.zh-CN: 这个是工作台。点开它，就能用你收集来的材料合成新东西。

text.en: Oh — and if you ever get busy, just tap me and ask! I love lending a paw.
text.zh-CN: 对了——你要是忙不过来，点我一下说一声就行！我最爱帮忙啦。

text.en: Okay! Let's make this little island bloom together, {name}.
text.zh-CN: 好啦！我们一起让这座小岛热闹起来吧，{name}。
